critical_code_review_comments: Optional polish: consider adding prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable float-emblem/pulse-glow for accessibility.
The emblem img is decorative — add alt='' (or descriptive alt) and role='presentation' if purely decorative to satisfy a11y.
The .login-shell background pulls a remote Unsplash image at runtime; consider self-hosting to avoid third-party CDN dependency for a demo shown to leadership.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All login page visual fixes verified working on production preview URL. Auth is entirely mocked in App.js — no backend or DB. Emblem asset at /logos/emblem.png, animations float-emblem + pulse-glow confirmed via computed style. Dashboard route conditionally renders inside App.js on authed=true.
